scenes.en: Here's why, and when it's urgent
scenes.say: Waking up with puffy eyes? Here's why it happens, and when it's urgent.

scenes.en: Lying flat all night lets fluid settle in the thin skin around the eyes
scenes.ta: இரவில் படுத்திருக்கும்போது கண்ணைச் சுற்றி நீர் தேங்கும்
scenes.say: When you lie flat all night, fluid settles in the thin, loose skin around your eyes. Once you are up and moving, it usually drains away.

scenes.en: Salty dinner, late nights, crying, allergies, rubbing
scenes.say: Common triggers are a salty dinner, late nights, crying, allergies, and rubbing your eyes.

scenes.en: Eyelid skin is among the thinnest skin on your body
scenes.say: Did you know? Eyelid skin is among the thinnest skin on your body. That's why fluid shows there first.

scenes.en: Cool, clean cloth for 5 minutes. Sleep well, head a little raised. Less salt at night.
scenes.ta: குளிர்ந்த துணியை மூடிய கண் மேல் வையுங்கள்
scenes.say: Try this. Place a cool, clean cloth on closed eyes for five minutes. Sleep well with your head a little raised, and eat less salt at night.

scenes.en: Rubbing makes swelling and itching worse
scenes.say: And don't rub. It makes swelling and itching worse.

scenes.en: Pain, redness, fever, vision change, or one eye badly swollen
scenes.ta: வலி, சிவப்பு, காய்ச்சல் இருந்தால் உடனே மருத்துவரிடம்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if swelling comes with pain, redness, fever, a change in vision, or if one eye is badly swollen.

scenes.en: Swollen feet too? See a doctor. Book an eye test.
scenes.say: If puffiness comes every day with swollen feet, see a doctor for a check-up. And book an eye test.
